title: Search queries fail on large repositories (>50k files)
body: When executing full-text search across large workspaces, the search engine times out after 30 seconds with 504 Gateway Timeout. We need indexing optimizations and debounced query execution.

title: Search filters (by tag and author) do not return matching tickets
body: Filtering by author:alex or tag:frontend returns empty results even when tickets exist. The elastic query parser appears to drop boolean filters.

title: Fuzzy search matching produces high false positive rates
body: Typing 'login' matches unrelated tickets like 'logging'. We should adjust edit distance threshold or use dense embedding cosine ranking.

title: Feature Request: Regex support in global search
body: Power users require regex matching capability in the search input bar to match pattern-based error codes.

title: Search latency spikes during concurrent peak usage
body: P99 search latency jumps from 150ms to 4200ms when more than 100 concurrent queries hit the retrieval endpoint.

title: Memory leak in WebSocket notification daemon
body: Background process RSS memory grows by 200MB/hour due to unclosed socket connections.

title: OAuth token expiration causes silent sync failures
body: When Google OAuth access token expires after 1 hour, background refresh token flow fails without prompting user to re-authenticate.

title: Add keyboard shortcuts for search navigation (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K)
body: Implementing a universal command palette shortcut would significantly boost navigation speed for engineers.
